jobs.prompt: Roadmap S2 tickets T-0051, T-0052 (R-013: 'A ticket that blocks, or fails twice, is re-split or rerouted without the orchestrator writing a manifest. The re-plan is logged with its reason.' T-0052: 'swarm scope sync logs a replan event with the ticket id and reason. A replanned ticket returns to ready with smaller files or a different lane.') and T-0038, T-0039 (R-007: 'The splitter sizes tickets by file bytes per lane (for example the Hermes 15 KB limit), not only file count. A ticket too large for every cheap lane is split or routed to a lane that edits in place.' T-0039: 'scope split --ingest routes an oversize ticket to an in-place lane or refuses with a split hint. swarm scope approve warns when a ticket exceeds the active lane byte budget.'). Modules exist on main with NO callers: tools/ticket-replan.mjs (gatesCountForTicket, ticketQualifiesForReplan, replanPlanForTicket, applyReplanToTicket, replanTickets, replanLedger, persistReplans(root, ledger, { now, by })) and tools/lane-size.mjs (HERMES_CAP_BYTES, LANE_CAP_BYTES, IN_PLACE_LANES, CHEAP_LANE_ORDER, capBytesForLane, ticketOutputFiles, ticketByteTotal, sizeTicketForLane, fittingLanes, adviseTicketLane). Verify each against its ticket acceptance; fix a module only if a test shows a gap. Wire in tools/scope-commands.mjs: (a) cmdSync (scope sync): after its existing retry handling, tickets that are blocked or have two failed attempts (read how sync/tickets record attempts/failures) are passed through replanLedger/persistReplans; each replan writes a tickets.log event { event: 'replan', id, reason, plan } (persistReplans may already do this — reuse) and the ticket returns to ready with smaller files (a re-split) or a different lane; tickets owned by a human, sensitive tickets that need review, or tickets in review are never auto-replanned; print one line per replan. (b) scope split --ingest: size every ingested ticket with adviseTicketLane using real file sizes (stat existing files; new files count 0); a ticket too large for every cheap lane is routed to an in-place lane (set ticket.lane to the advised in-place lane, recorded in the ingest output) or, if none fits, the ingest refuses with a split hint naming the ticket, its bytes and the cap. (c) scope approve: warn (not refuse) per ticket that exceeds its active lane's byte budget. Do NOT edit tools/tickets.mjs (another job owns it this wave), tools/swarm.mjs or the tools/swarm folder. Tests: tests/scope-sync-replan.test.mjs (T-0052) and tests/scope-split-lane-size.test.mjs (T-0039), extend tests/ticket-replan.test.mjs and tests/lane-size.test.mjs only if a gap needs it; node:test, temp git repos, injected deps/clock (no wall clock, env, TTY). Cases: a ticket failed twice is replanned on sync, logged with reason, back to ready; a review ticket is not touched; an ingest ticket whose outputs total 40 KB is routed to an in-place lane (cursor/codex), one exceeding every lane is refused with the hint; approve warns on an oversize ticket. Keep tests/scope-ingest-paths.test.mjs, tests/scope-ingest-waves.test.mjs, tests/scope-commands.test.mjs, tests/batch-a-eval.test.mjs, tests/lesson-40-eval.test.mjs green. Run `node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test tests/scope-sync-replan.test.mjs tests/scope-split-lane-size.test.mjs tests/ticket-replan.test.mjs tests/lane-size.test.mjs tests/scope-ingest-paths.test.mjs tests/scope-ingest-waves.test.mjs tests/scope-commands.test.mjs tests/batch-a-eval.test.mjs tests/lesson-40-eval.test.mjs` and `node tools/check-package.mjs`. Tests in ignoreTests (and ledger fixture JSON that only mentions file names) use these files for unrelated behavior; the coordinator runs the FULL suite (env -u CLAUDECODE npm test).

Roadmap S2 tickets T-0053 and T-0054 (R-014: 'A delete-only ticket passes sync once its files are gone. Rename and migration tickets have their own type with matching checks.' T-0054: 'validateTicket accepts a rename ticket with exactly one new file and one deletes entry. A migration ticket still requires DDL-only files under supabase/migrations.'). (1) New module tools/ticket-sync-checks.mjs (ESM, SPDX header), pure + injected fs: `deleteOnlyTicketPasses(ticket, { exists })` true when ticket.files is empty and every ticket.deletes path no longer exists; `renameTicketCheck(ticket, { exists })` -> { ok, problems } for type 'rename': exactly one new file in files and exactly one deletes entry; after the work: the new file exists and the old one does not; `migrationTicketCheck(ticket, { readFile })` -> { ok, problems } for type 'migration': every file under supabase/migrations/ (read how tests/lesson-39-integrate.test.mjs and the existing migration rules in tools/tickets.mjs / tools/migration-gate.mjs describe DDL-only) contains only DDL; `syncCheckForTicket(ticket, deps)` dispatching by type/shape and returning { ok, problems, kind: 'delete-only'|'rename'|'migration'|'normal' }. (2) tools/tickets.mjs: TYPES gains 'rename'; validateTicket accepts a rename ticket with exactly one new file and exactly one deletes entry (and rejects other shapes with a clear message), keeps migration rules unchanged, and keeps every other ticket type's validation identical. Do NOT edit tools/scope-commands.mjs (another job owns it this wave; wiring into scope sync is a later ticket T-0055), tools/swarm.mjs or the tools/swarm folder. Tests: tests/ticket-sync-checks.test.mjs (T-0053) and tests/ticket-rename-type.test.mjs (T-0054), node:test, injected fs fakes, no wall clock/env: delete-only passes once files are gone and fails while one remains; rename ok/failing shapes; migration DDL-only ok vs a file with DML (INSERT/UPDATE) rejected; validateTicket rename acceptance and rejection. Keep tests/tickets*.test.mjs, tests/scope-delete-tickets.test.mjs, tests/lesson-39-integrate.test.mjs, tests/mark-deps.test.mjs green. Run `node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test tests/ticket-sync-checks.test.mjs tests/ticket-rename-type.test.mjs tests/scope-delete-tickets.test.mjs tests/lesson-39-integrate.test.mjs tests/mark-deps.test.mjs tests/tickets-delivered.test.mjs` and `node tools/check-package.mjs`. Tests in ignoreTests (and ledger fixture JSON that only mentions file names) use these files for unrelated behavior; the coordinator runs the FULL suite (env -u CLAUDECODE npm test).
